description: Staff Personality. From our full video: 4 Instagram Reels You Can Film in 1 Hour.

scenes.narration: Reel three is personality. Let one staff member answer a fun question on camera. Example question: 'What’s your secret coffee hack?' Keep answers 8 to 12 seconds. Customers connect with faces and repeat visits follow when they feel a relationship.
